root_cause: The Spotify website does not provide a traditional booking/enquiry/quote request form. The Contact Us page only offers alternative support channels (message us, community forum, specialized help centers) rather than a contact form where users can submit enquiries or request quotes.
fix: Developers should consider adding a dedicated booking/enquiry form on the Contact Us page if they intend to facilitate such interactions. Alternatively, they could enhance the AI-powered search feature to better handle booking and quote requests.
